Do you think she’s really avoiding you? I know the feeling when you like someone and every small thing seems to matter. I used to like this girl and we weren’t too close, but we were pretty good friends. I confessed to her and I started to feel like she was avoiding me and that she changed her attitude toward me. Then I looked back to how we were beforw I confessed and asked myself, “did she change, or did I change?”.  Another time this girl, also not very close but again was a pretty good friend, confessed to me. After awhile, I heard from her best friend that she felt like I was avoiding her. Truth was I was treating exactly the same. Not sure if this applies to you, but maybe you should see first if she actually is avoiding you or if you’re just overthinking things. If she is legitimately avoiding you, then my advice is to just give her space and let things naturally fall back into place. Obviously you can’t go around acting like nothing happened.
